# Humanoid Xenomorph
Manifesting from SCP-████, an anomalous movie ticket, Xenomorphs are humanoid alien creatures that the Foundation have given employment opportunities to, in order to placate them while further study is enacted. They possess acidic blood.
They recieve [color=#ffa500]5% more Piercing damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]an immunity to Cold damage and temperature[/color], [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage[/color], [color=#ffa500]25% more Shock damage[/color].
They experience hunger more quickly, needing to eat more often. While Xenomorphs are immune to ashpyxiation, that [color=reddoes not mean they are immune to the adverse effects of gases such as plasma![/color] They are unable to equip certain items: Space helmets, space suits, and boots — with the exceptions of leg wraps, magboots, and ninja shoes. They are capable of seeing in the dark, thanks to their advanced echolocation. Their blood acts as a potent acid. Their paws are impervious to glass shards, meaning Xenomorphs that walk over shards won't trip nor take damage.
